origin.description: Write the value of the previous top-level expression to the clipboard.

translation.description: Write one value to the clipboard.

arguments.name: value
arguments.text: The object to write. Python has no .Last.value, so the caller passes the value R would have stored.

translation.details: This calls write_clip(value). The argument replaces .Last.value.
translation.example:
from clipr import write_last_clip
print(write_last_clip("Write to clipboard", return_new=True))
